summary: Broadcom Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing pricing terms and results of cash tender offers for its outstanding senior notes. On June 17, 2026, Broadcom announced it would purchase, up to a $2.5 billion aggregate cap, six series of notes: 4.926% Senior Notes due 2037, 4.900% due 2038, 5.050% due 2030, 5.200% due 2032, 5.150% due 2031, and 4.900% due 2032. Pricing was set per the Offer to Purchase dated June 11, 2026. No board recommendation, advisor, premium percentage, or specific price per note was disclosed. The tender is a liability-management transaction to reduce debt. Watch for completion timeline and potential upsize.
